paragraph: To **earn** money, you have to work. He **earns** three times more than I do. I wish I **earned** more money.
english: to gain (success, reward, recognition) through applied effort or work
arabicDesc: مثال: كي تربح المال، عليك أن تعمل.

paragraph: Why are you **packing** up? Do you have anything to eat in your **pack**? There was a **pack** of paper on the table.
english: bundle to be carried
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تجمع أمتعتك؟

other.meaning: To put or bring things together in a limited or confined space, especially for storage or transport (verb)

paragraph: The book was checked out from our local **library**. Can you tell me the way to the **library**? Please do not write in this **library** book.
english: institution which holds books, etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: استُعير الكتاب من مكتبتنا المحلّيّة.

paragraph: We don't have time to **conduct** a detailed study. Everyone of us is responsible for his own **conduct**. The girl was given a prize for good **conduct**.
english: to organize and do something; also a person's behavior

paragraph: When was the last time you rode a **horse**? The **horse** stopped and refused to move. He's as strong as a **horse**.
english: members of the species ''Equus ferus''
arabicDesc: مثال: متى كانت آخر مرة ركبت فيها حصانا؟

paragraph: I would like batteries for this **device**. You're already paying to carry a tracking **device** around. Do you know how to turn this **device** on?
english: piece of equipment
arabicDesc: مثال: أرغب ببطاريات لهذا الجهاز.

paragraph: The shop only allows payment in **cash**. Fill her up with regular. I am paying **cash**. How much **cash** do you usually have on you?
english: money in the form of notes/bills and coins
arabicDesc: مثال: يقبل المحل الدفع نقدًا فقط.

paragraph: Our family has lived here for **generations**. We have married each other for **generations**. He is the person to lead the next **generation**.
english: the act of creating something or bringing something into being
arabicDesc: مثال: عاشت عائلتنا هنا لأجيال خلت.

paragraph: He can speak both Japanese and English with **facility**. Everyone who works at the **facility** is extremely experienced. First, the waste is brought to the **facility**.
english: the physical means or contrivances to make something (especially a public service) possible
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: منشأة

paragraph: What **division** of the company do you work in? The **division** of Germany was considered a given until 1989. A major had to take command of the **division**.
english: the act or process of dividing anything

paragraph: How much is that **mountain** bike? I am thinking of going to the **mountains**. I would rather go to the **mountains** than to the beach.
english: large mass of earth and rock
arabicDesc: مثال: بكم هذه الدراجة الجبلية؟

paragraph: They are **struggling** for freedom. Getting customers into the store has been a **struggle**. It's been quite a **struggle** to get this far.
english: to strive, to labour in difficulty, to fight
arabicDesc: مثال: إنهم يكافحون من أجل الحرية.

paragraph: That student is very **active**. He's **active** at night, during the day he rests. I think it takes a while to become **active**.
english: having the quality or power of acting
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الطالب نشيط جدًا.

other.meaning: given to action rather than contemplation

paragraph: The rules of evidence are the same as **civil**. He entered **civil** service 20 years ago right after college. The **civil** rights movement leads to a dream.
english: related to people and government office as opposed to military or religion
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أهلي

paragraph: It's his problem. It's **none** of my business. **None** of the computers can continue to run with a burnt card. **None** of my friends drink coffee.
english: not any thing
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه مشكلته و أنا لست معنيا بشأنه.

paragraph: He didn't **collect** enough evidence. The mother made an effort to **collect** her thoughts. We do not **collect** any information about the users.
english: to gather together
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يجمع ما يكفي من الأدلة.

paragraph: It's easy to get her to **spread** her legs. We're hoping to stop the **spread** of the disease. A fire can **spread** faster than people can run.
english: act of spreading

paragraph: We ate a whole **load** of apples. I suppose you must have a **load** of fans. It took a little while to **load** the page.
english: to put a load on or in
arabicDesc: مثال: أكلنا شحنة كاملة من التفاح.

paragraph: Could you place your bags on the **scale**, please? The **scale** seems to be off by two pounds. Our roads and our bridges need large-**scale** repairs.
english: an ordered, usually numerical sequence used for measurement

other.meaning: gradation; progressive series; scheme of comparative rank or order

paragraph: He is an **executive** in an insurance company. One must be an **executive** in some company. I am the **executive** director of the museum.
english: designed or fitted for execution, or carrying into effect

paragraph: I **assume** the two of you know each other. I **assumed** that was why you called me. I **assume** that you'll not come to work tomorrow.
english: to suppose to be true
arabicDesc: مثال: أفترض أنكما تعرفان بعضكما.

paragraph: You have only three options to **select**. Click here to **select** the objects across all pages. **Select** all objects on this page for an action.
english: to choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options
arabicDesc: مثال: أمامك ثلاث خيارات لا غير للاختيار بينها.

paragraph: Human activities threaten the local **environment**. Maintaining peace in a shared **environment** can be hard. We must create a safe **environment** for our children.
english: area around something
arabicDesc: مثال: تهدّد النّشاطات البشريّة البيئة المحلّيّة.

paragraph: Can you work on **multiple** projects with different teams? He has to take on **multiple** tables at once. Remember to save your important files in **multiple** locations.
english: a whole number that is obtained by multiplying a specific whole number by another whole number

paragraph: This sentence states exactly how the **writer** feels. What do you think of those Japanese **writers**? Let me introduce a promising young **writer** to you.
english: person who writes; an author
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الجملة تصف بالتحديد مشاعر الكاتب.

paragraph: I am not **gay**, but my boyfriend is. I love him, but he's **gay**. **Gay** marriage should be legal.
english: homosexual — see also homosexual, lesbian
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لست مثلي الجنس، لكن أصدقائي الذكور مثليون

other.meaning: A homosexual, especially a male homosexual (noun)

paragraph: Where is your business **located**? It took one week to **locate** their hiding place. Can you **locate** this place on the map for me?
english: to find where something is
arabicDesc: مثال: أين يقع محلك؟

paragraph: If you're wrong, **admit** it. If you're right, be quiet. He will **admit** it sooner or later. If you make a mistake, don't be afraid to **admit** it.
english: concede as true
arabicDesc: مثال: إن كنت مخطئا، فاعترف. إن كنت محقّا، فاصمت.

paragraph: I remember I saw the **queen**. I am the **queen** of France. Mother, mother, you are the **queen** of my heart.
english: female monarch
arabicDesc: مثال: أذكر أنني رأيت الملكة.

other.meaning: To make a queen or (figuratively) to give the status of a queen (verb)

paragraph: Have you been able to **confirm** all of this? Could you please **confirm** that for me in writing? I can't **confirm** that's the actual number of deaths.
english: to strengthen
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أثبت

paragraph: He learnt of the **mass** deaths in the area. I always go to Holy **Mass** on Sunday morning. Newspapers, television, and radio are called the **mass** media.
english: matter, material
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: وزن

paragraph: We **estimate** the damages to be one thousand dollars. Please **estimate** the losses by Friday at the latest. Could you give me an **estimate** before starting work?
english: to guess a number or amount carefully

paragraph: In **Africa**, there is no difference between a white and a black. France never actually left **Africa**. He is said to have been born in **Africa**.
english: the continent that is south of Europe, east of the Atlantic Ocean, west of the Indian Ocean and north of Antarctica
arabicDesc: مثال: في أفريقيا ليس هناك فرق بين الأبيض والأسود.

paragraph: It was **awesome** to meet you in real life! I can see you are having an **awesome** time. It would really be **awesome** if you could come.
english: very good; also causing great admiration
arabicDesc: مثال: كان أمرا رائعا اللّقاء معك وجها لوجه!

paragraph: Explain the fact as **clearly** as possible. I remember the event as **clearly** as if it had happened just yesterday. I'm **clearly** not needed here anymore, so I'm leaving.
english: in a way that is easy to see, hear or understand
arabicDesc: مثال: فسر الأحداث بأوضح طريقة ممكن.

paragraph: He is **learning** how to drive a car. Neither students nor teachers should ever stop **learning**. My students are **learning** to drive.
english: action of the verb
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه يتعلم قيادة السيارة.

paragraph: **Sunday** is the first day of the week. Today is Saturday and tomorrow will be **Sunday**. It seems like years since **Sunday** morning.
english: day of the week
arabicDesc: مثال: يوم الأحد هو أول يوم في الأسبوع.

paragraph: **Click** the picture to go to the next page! **Click** on the button below to confirm your order. To leave a comment, **click** on the text box below.
english: the act of snapping one's fingers

other.meaning: To cause to make a click (verb)

paragraph: The life of the patient hangs in the **balance**. The two factors need to **balance** each other out. My **balance** ran out, so I can't call you.
english: a state in which opposing forces harmonise

paragraph: I would help you if you were in **trouble**. The **trouble** is that they have no money. At first he had **trouble** getting used to his new house.
english: distressful or dangerous situation
arabicDesc: مثال: إن كنت في مشكل، فسأساعدك.

paragraph: This will be our last **session** for the year. Will you answer these questions in a closed **session**? He guided the students through a library research **session**.
english: a period of time devoted to a particular activity

other.meaning: meeting of a body to conduct business

paragraph: I am not the **captain** of the new team. We elected her **captain** of our team. The **captain** told us to get off the ship.
english: the person lawfully in command of a sea-going vessel
arabicDesc: مثال: لست قبطان الفريق الجديد.

other.meaning: the person lawfully in command of an airliner
an army officer with a rank between the most senior grade of lieutenant and major
one of the athletes on a sports team designated to make decisions

paragraph: Do you have a **guide** map of the city? I can be your tour **guide** if you want. Have you got a travel **guide** for this city?
english: someone who guides
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مرشد سياحي

other.meaning: To serve as a guide for someone or something (verb)

paragraph: I will have time for my **grand**-mother tomorrow. We must think of our children and **grand**-children. My **grand** parents planned a boat trip with us.
english: large and impressive

paragraph: Where did that **injury** on your foot come from? The **injury** was more serious than they had supposed. I am concerned, maybe he will receive an **injury**.
english: damage to the body of a living thing
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: إصابة

paragraph: The **bird** flew away and was lost to sight. What do you call this **bird** in English? The boy captured the **bird** with a net.
english: a girl or woman, especially one considered sexually attractive
arabicDesc: مثال: حلق الطائر بعيداً حتى غاب عن الأنظار.

paragraph: We'll have to pay back that **loan** one way or another. English has many **loan** words from French. They took out a **loan** to build their house.
english: borrowed sum of money or other property
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن سوف نسدد هذا القرض بطريقة أو بأخرى.

paragraph: He remains popular with the party **rank** and file. His **rank** isn't high enough for that position. A major is above a captain in **rank**.
english: a row of people or things organized in a grid pattern, often soldiers

paragraph: We are trapped in an alternative **reality**. People have no idea what is happening in **reality**. This is the **reality** and we must accept it.
english: state of being actual or real
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن عالقون في واقع بديل.

other.meaning: entirety of all that is real

paragraph: The **guard** was on duty all night. We have three security **guards** who take shifts. A police officer was standing **guard** by the door.
english: person who or thing that protects something
arabicDesc: مثال: حرس الحارس الليل بطوله.

paragraph: There was nobody who could come to your **aid**. Please give me a Band-**Aid** and some medicine. No one appeared who wanted to come to our **aid**.
english: help

paragraph: This **joke** doesn't have anything to do with you. I meant it as a **joke**. I don't like this **joke**.
english: do for amusement
arabicDesc: مثال: لا علاقة لهذه النّكتة بك.

paragraph: How far is the **garden** from your house? There is a **garden** at the back of my house. There are many red flowers in the **garden**.
english: piece of land outside with flowers and plants
arabicDesc: مثال: كم تبعد الحديقة عن منزلك؟

paragraph: I have a good opinion of the young **candidate**. No one expected him to be a **candidate** again. He ran as a **candidate**, independent of any party.
english: a person who seeks to be elected or appointed to a position or privilege
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مرشحة

paragraph: I met her in the **winter** several years ago. I wanted to get you some clothes for the **winter**. It's very cold this **winter**.
english: fourth season, marked by short days and the lowest temperatures
arabicDesc: مثال: التقيت بها ذات شتاء قبل عدة سنوات.

paragraph: They wanted an **economy** car. The town developed into the center of the **economy**. The growth of the world **economy** is slowing down.
english: effective management of the resources of a community or system
arabicDesc: مثال: كانوا يريدون سيارة اقتصادية.

paragraph: Don't forget to leave a **tip**. Did you leave a **tip**? You were the one who gave me that **tip**.
english: small amount of money left for a servant as a token of appreciation
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس ترك إكراميّة.

other.meaning: To give a small gratuity to, especially to an employee of someone who provides a service (verb)

paragraph: His **behavior** makes me sick. I can't put up with your **behavior** any longer. Her **behavior** at the party was far from perfect.
english: way matter or systems behave
arabicDesc: مثال: سلوكه يشعرني بالغثيان.

other.meaning: way an animal or human behaves or acts

paragraph: You can't **stick** your head out of the window. It's dangerous. You must **stick** to your diet. Do you remember our being **stuck** in the snow with the car last winter?
english: an elongated piece of wood or similar material, typically put to some use, for example as a wand or baton
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يجب أن تخرج رأسك من النّافذة. هذا خطير.

paragraph: Can you **recommend** a good doctor? I highly **recommend** watching this movie. If I were going to buy a boat, what kind of boat would you **recommend**?
english: to commend to the favorable notice of another
arabicDesc: مثال: هلّا نصحتني بطبيب جيّد؟

paragraph: He had led the **Republican** Party with great success. He was a member of the **Republican** Party. He became active in the **Republican** Party.
english: advocating or supporting a republic as a form of government, advocating or supporting republicanism

paragraph: I don't want to play here on this **surface**. Never leave the baby alone on a high **surface**. The **surface** of the water was still as glass.
english: the external boundary of an object or body

paragraph: Can I pick my **ticket** up at the airport? I told them to send me another **ticket**. Where can I buy a **ticket**?
english: admission to entertainment
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكاني أن آخذ تذكرتي في المطار؟

paragraph: The **lake** is a long way from here. That hotel was very near the **lake**. Finally we arrived at the **lake**.
english: body of water
arabicDesc: مثال: البحيرة بعيدة جداً عن هنا.

paragraph: We tried to project our **analysis** into the future. The form of the text has value in **analysis**. This is a good place to start the **analysis**.
english: decomposition into components in order to study (a complex thing, concept, theory, etc.)

paragraph: You have never wanted to study **anyway**. I was going out **anyway**. What time is it, **anyway**?
english: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت لم تُرِِد أن تدرس أبداً على أي حال.

paragraph: Will you be home for **Christmas**? It was like **Christmas** morning. It's time to get started with the **Christmas** shopping.
english: a number of places in the United States:
arabicDesc: مثال: هل ستكون في البلاد وقت عيد الميلاد؟

paragraph: You don't give up too **easily**, do you? You shouldn't let him go that **easily**. You shouldn't have given up so **easily**.
english: without difficulty
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت لا تستسلم بسهولة جداً، أليس كذلك؟

paragraph: I am an **Indian** and I come from India. We plan to eat dinner at an **Indian** restaurant. **Indian** women are not allowed to work outside their houses.
english: of or relating to India or its people

other.meaning: A person from the country of India (noun)

paragraph: I **literally** didn't understand a word you just said. I didn't mean that **literally** when I said that. He didn't **literally** say that but something like that.
english: in a literal manner
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بٱلحرف

paragraph: He was someone who made his own **luck**. Don't set your failure down to bad **luck**. Some people believe that the number 13 brings bad **luck**.
english: something that happens to someone by chance
arabicDesc: مثال: هو من صنع حظه بنفسه.

paragraph: It is **necessary** for you to start at once. I think it is **necessary** for them to go there. Please do what you consider **necessary**.
english: needed, required
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تبدأ حالاً.

paragraph: It was ever **thus**, and so will it remain. **Thus** I tell you don't just go alone. **Thus**, we can point out the result in our discussion.
english: in this way or manner
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كذا

paragraph: Not until **yesterday** did I know of the event. **Yesterday** I was not at home the whole day. I can't remember what I had to eat **yesterday**.
english: day before today
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أعلم بهذا الحدث حتى البارحة.

paragraph: I enjoyed the concert except that the **hall** was cold. This road leads to the public **hall**. I've booked the **hall** for Thursday.
english: large meeting room
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد أعجبني الحفل، لكن القاعة كانت باردة.

paragraph: I need to decide what I have to **achieve**. I'll do whatever it takes to **achieve** my goal. I try all things, I **achieve** what I can.
english: to carry out or conclude (something, as a task) successfully

paragraph: At last, we arrived at the **village**. The world is a small **village**. We came by a tiny **village** on our way to the country.
english: a rural habitation of size between a hamlet and a town
arabicDesc: مثال: و أخيراً وصلنا إلى القرية.

paragraph: Man consists of **soul** and body. I didn't see a **soul**. He put all his heart and **soul** into it.
english: the spirit or essence of anything
arabicDesc: مثال: يتكوّن الإنسان من نفس و جسد.

paragraph: You and I seem to **argue** a lot. Don't **argue** when you are angry and don't eat when you are full. They haven't stopped **arguing** since they went in there.
english: to debate, disagree, or discuss opposing or differing viewpoints
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدو أننا نتخاصم كثيرا أنا و أنت.

paragraph: He began to work to get **Congress** to reduce taxes. The **congress** is to be held next year. The next **congress** may take place in Africa.
english: legislative body
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كونجرس

paragraph: She lost her only son in the **traffic** accident. These two cities have the same **traffic** rules. I lost my wife in a **traffic** accident.
english: pedestrians or vehicles on roads or on the air
arabicDesc: مثال: فقدتْ ابنها الوحيد في حادث مروري.

paragraph: My body is old but my **spirit** is young. He didn't break my heart. He broke my **spirit**. The **spirit** of Christmas is about giving and love.
english: the soul of a person or other creature

paragraph: There is no **distance** on this earth as far away as yesterday. From this **distance**, you can't make out the letters. At a **distance**, the ship looks like an island.
english: (countable, uncountable) amount of space between points
arabicDesc: مثال: ليست هناك مسافة على هذه الأرض أبعد من يوم أمس.

other.meaning: Often followed by from: to set (someone or something) at a distance (noun sense 1.1) from someone or something else (verb)

paragraph: He is a very **smart** boy. This dog is very **smart**. She's really **smart**, isn't she?
english: exhibiting intellectual knowledge, such as that found in books
arabicDesc: مثال: هو ولد ذكي جدا.

paragraph: The tree **casts** a shadow on the wall. Her letter **cast** a new light on the matter. You can **cast** your vote at a polling station.
english: to move, or be moved, away
arabicDesc: مثال: تلقي الشجرة بظلالها على الحائط.

paragraph: She **refused** my offer to help her. She **refused** to accept the money. You should have **refused** his offer.
english: (transitive) decline (request, demand)
arabicDesc: مثال: رفضت مساعدتي.

paragraph: You can go there **directly** by bus or by train. This product will be delivered **directly** to your door. I wanted to say thank you to you **directly**.
english: in a direct manner
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكانك أن تذهب إلى هناك مباشرة بالحافلة أو بالقطار.

paragraph: **Germany** is not only beautiful, it's also rich. Do you want to live in **Germany**? He wrote me every week from **Germany**.
english: country in Central Europe
arabicDesc: مثال: ألمانيا ليست جميلة فحسب، بل هي غنية أيضا.

paragraph: I am **glad** no one is around. I'm **glad** you were able to come. I'm really **glad** to hear that.
english: pleased
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا سعيد لأنّه لا يوجد أحد هنا.

paragraph: The **overall** cost of the work will be about $200. The **overall** trend shows a decline in bird species. A well-balanced diet will benefit your **overall** health.
english: including everything; in general

paragraph: He made a **speech** in which he supported my opinions. You're giving a **speech** tomorrow aren't you? Did you learn that **speech** by heart?
english: an oration, session of speaking
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد ألقى خطاباً دَعم فيه آرائي.

paragraph: This kind of picture does not **appeal** to me. There was a look of **appeal** in her eyes. We must **appeal** to public opinion about the matter.
english: an application to a superior court or judge for a decision or order by an inferior court or judge to be reviewed and overturned
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: استئناف

other.meaning: To apply to a superior court or judge to review and overturn (a decision or order by an inferior court or judge) (verb)

paragraph: My six-year-old has just started **primary** school. Which subject you liked the most in **primary** school? His **primary** goal in life was to have fun.
english: first or earliest in a group or series

paragraph: He's in his **element** when working on the farm. We'll have the **element** of surprise on our side. The key to success is the **element** of surprise.
english: simplest or essential part or principle of anything

paragraph: The **soldiers** are working hard. We need **soldiers**, not monsters. Are these **soldiers** or monsters?
english: member of an army
arabicDesc: مثال: الجنود يعملون بجد.

paragraph: Do you **bet** on horses? I **bet** everyone is waiting. I **bet** you haven't seen anything like that before.
english: to stake or pledge upon the outcome of an event
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تراهن على الخيول؟

paragraph: On the **bus**, there isn't enough room for everyone. There is no **bus** service in the area. I want you all in the back of the **bus**.
english: a motor vehicle for transporting large numbers of people along roads
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يوجد مكان يكفي للجميع على متن الحافلة.

paragraph: This tie doesn't go with my **suit**. Where did you have your **suit** made? Where did he get that **suit**?
english: set of clothes
arabicDesc: مثال: ربطة العنق هذه لا تليق ببزتي.

paragraph: My internet **connection** was cut off. The internet **connection** just stops and then comes back. I can't do my job without an internet **connection**.
english: point at which two or more things are joined
arabicDesc: مثال: انقطع اتصالي بالإنترنت.

paragraph: A woman like you doesn't **deserve** a man like me. Children **deserve** love and protection from their mothers. I think I don't **deserve** you.
english: to be entitled to, as a result of past actions
arabicDesc: مثال: امرأةً مثلك لا تستحق رجلاً مثلي.
